claims.claim: Reddit Q2 2026 revenue grew 61% year over year to $805M while DAUq grew 18% to 130.3M and WAUq grew 24% to 514.6M.
Reddit joined the S&P 500 effective August 18, 2026, a market-structure milestone that may broaden passive/index ownership but does not itself prove operating improvement.

factors.name: community monetization
factors.basis: Revenue materially outgrew daily-user growth while engagement scale continued expanding.

factors.name: index inclusion
factors.basis: S&P 500 inclusion broadens institutional/index exposure but is not fundamental evidence by itself.

risks.risk: Advertising remains the dominant revenue source, exposing results to ad-market cycles and platform demand concentration.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of >60% revenue growth cannot be inferred beyond disclosed periods.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 marked Reddit's eighth consecutive quarter above 60% revenue growth; net income reached $253M and free cash flow $261M, both more than doubling year over year.

factors.name: growth-to-cash conversion
factors.basis: Rapid top-line growth coincided with substantial net income and free cash flow rather than relying solely on user expansion.

risks.risk: Strong recent execution raises the expectation bar; deceleration in advertising growth or engagement monetization could produce a large expectations gap.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not assert a live valuation or security entry point.
